lines.x: 'Lens will be happy to take care of any tasks meant for Miss Scene!'

'Miss Scene has won both Nature and Still-Life categories in major photography competitions. With a patient enough subject, her chances of winning the Portrait category are likely to skyrocket as well. Doctor, would you pose for Miss Scene?'
'Evaluating patience: Doctor's levels declining. Initiating comfort protocol—Miss Scene will finish shooting in less than 30 minutes. Hold on just a bit longer, please.'
'The Zalak next door is visiting Miss Scene again. She might not be laughing yet, but I can tell she's very happy.'

'Truthfully, Miss Scene was originally set to work as a full-time photographer for a photographic equipment giant in Columbia, but somehow ended up here as an operator. Lens assesses that she likely chose to leave because they wanted her to photograph subjects she did not appreciate. Yes, indeed, Miss Scene is that picky.'
W h e n y o u s e e s o m e t h i n g y o u l i k e , t a k e a p h o t o a n d s a v e i t.

'Doctor, are you attempting to make Miss Scene laugh again? She's actually already laughing, though seeing her smile requires patience. You wait, and wait, and wait some more, until the arc of her mouth reaches absolute perfection. This process might take… TBD minutes, it all depends on Miss Scene's mood today.'

'Lens has long been waiting for someone who understands Miss Scene. Now, many at Rhodes Island are willing to approach her, and this brings Lens joy. I hope that one day, Miss Scene will find a biological entity that can perfectly replace Lens.'
T h i s c a m e r a. F o r y o u. T h a n k y o u. D o c t o r.
'Now Playing: D.D.D. Smash Hits'.
'Photographer, Scene, and Robotic Photography Assistant, Lens. We are pleased to make your acquaintance.' H e l l o.
'Replay requested. Repeat: replay requested.'
'Accessory upgrade complete. Miss Scene thanks you.'
I s t h e r e s c e n e r y y o u w a n t t o s e e?
'Teammates' data acquired.'
'Sub-data acquired.'
'Green-light, confirmed.'
'Cruise program initiated.'
'Lens is here to serve you.'
H e r e.
'Camera rolling.'
M h m m.
'Shooting—'
'Exposure—'
'Panorama—'
'Time lapse—'
C o n g r a t s.
'Mission complete! Escorting Miss Scene back to base.'
'The route back to the base seems bumpy.'
'Evacuate immediately. Repeat: Evacuate immediately.'
'Please arrange a hammock for Miss Scene. Thank you.'
Y e a h?
W a n t a p h o t o?
Arknights.
I n e e d t o w i s h y o u a h a p p y n e w y e a r m y s e l f. H a p p y n e w y e a r. 'Me too! Doctor, Happy New Year! Happy New Year!'
H e l l o. 'Hello! Hi!'
H a p p y b i r t h d a y. T h a n k y o u f o r a l w a y s l i s t e n i n g s o p a t i e n t l y t o m e. T h i s i s m y f a v o r i t e p i c t u r e t h i s y e a r. Y o u c a n h a v e i t.

'Miss Scene isn't suited to such a lively party. She would be overwhelmed. So, Lens will accompany her with a drink. Doctor, what would you like Lens to do? Lens's music library has been updated with three songs. Please press here to make a selection!'
